import '../' import { useDispatch } from 'react-redux' import { editedProfile } from '../../../../../store/slices/UserSlice' export default function AboutMeEdit({profile}) { const handlerSubmit = async (e) => { const dispatch = useDispatch e.preventDefault() const [FirstName,LastName,Age,Bio,Location,Profession,Hobbies] = e.target const newUser = { id: profile.id, FirstName: FirstName.value, LastName: LastName.value, Age: Age.value, Bio: Bio.value, Location: Location.value, Profession: Profession.value, Hobbies: Hobbies.value, Image: profile.Image, } await fetch(`http://localhost:3005/Loged_User/${profile.id}`, { method: 'PATCH', body: JSON.stringify(newUser), }) dispatch(editedProfile(newUser)) } return (
) }
